verdict.rationale: No evidence Runloop supports running a headless browser or desktop GUI inside its Devbox sandboxes; the only browser-related tutorial explicitly states the architecture avoids this, running Chromium externally via Browserbase and connecting over CDP so 'no Chromium ever runs in the devbox.' Blueprints/docs never mention GUI, X11, VNC, or bundled browser binaries as a supported environment type.
